mapper.select: select sum(Sev_Days) from Sec_Expert_Vacation mn where mn.Ex_Id=#{exId} and mn.State=7

select ex.Ex_Name as exName, ex.Ex_Id_Type as exIdType, ex.Ex_Id_Number as exIdNumber, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Code as secCode, mn.* from Sec_Expert_Vacation mn left join Sec_Expert ex on mn.Ex_Id = ex.Ex_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id where mn.id = #{id}
